title: Don’t Use “Wang Ba”
synopsis: It’s important to know which words are offensive. But have you heard where this swear word comes from?

fullText.simplified:
不要用“王八”

    “王八”不是一个人名，不是姓王名八。“王八”最初是龟和鳖的统称，但现在更多是用来骂人，由此引申出来的骂人话有王八蛋、王八羔子、乌龟王八蛋等。用得最多的是“王八蛋”。
    “王八蛋”这句骂人的话是怎么来的呢？据说，和中国的“八德”有关。中国人自古重视德，认为做人最重要的有“八德”，分别是：孝、悌、忠、信、礼、义、廉、耻。这八德是做人的根本。如果有人违反了八德里的任何一项或多项，那就是一个不道德的人。对于那些人，人们就骂他们是“忘八德”。也许是“忘八德”和“王八蛋”的发音相近，慢慢地“王八蛋”就成了一句骂人话了。
    不忠不孝、不讲义气、不知羞耻、不懂礼节的人，都有可能被骂成“王八蛋”。“你这个王八蛋”是一句非常歹毒的骂人话，最好不要用。
fullText.traditional:
不要用“王八”

    “王八”不是一個人名，不是姓王名八。“王八”最初是龜和鱉的統稱，但現在更多是用來罵人，由此引申出來的罵人話有王八蛋、王八羔子、烏龜王八蛋等。用得最多的是“王八蛋”。
    “王八蛋”這句罵人的話是怎麼來的呢？據說，和中國的“八德”有關。中國人自古重視德，認為做人最重要的有“八德”，分別是：孝、悌、忠、信、禮、義、廉、恥。這八德是做人的根本。如果有人違反了八德裡的任何一項或多項，那就是一個不道德的人。對於那些人，人們就罵他們是“忘八德”。也許是“忘八德”和“王八蛋”的發音相近，慢慢地“王八蛋”就成了一句罵人話了。
    不忠不孝、不講義氣、不知羞恥、不懂禮節的人，都有可能被罵成“王八蛋”。“你這個王八蛋”是一句非常歹毒的罵人話，最好不要用。

raw.synopsis: It’s important to know which words are offensive. But have you heard where this swear word comes from?
sentence_translations: “Wang Ba” is not the name of a person. It is not the family name Wang and first name Ba.
“Wang Ba” was initially a general term for turtles and soft-shelled turtles, but is now used much more for swearing at people.
From this, the meaning has extended to the swear words bastard, son of a bitch, turtle bastard, et cetera.
How did this swear word “bastard” come about then? It is said, that it has to do with the Chinese “Eight Virtues”.
Chinese people have since ancient times attached importance to virtue.
The most important to consider upon conducting oneself are the “Eight Virtues”, that are divided into:
Filial piety, respect to one’s elder brother, loyalty, faith, propriety, righteousness, honesty, and sense of shame.
These Eight Virtues are essential to be an upright person.
If someone violates any one or many in the Eight Virtues, then they are an immoral person.
Concerning those persons, people may accuse them of being “Forgetful of the Eight Virtues”.
Perhaps “wang ba de” and “wang ba dan” sound about the same, and slowly changed into a swear word.
People that are disloyal and unfilial, don’t speak loyally, have lost all sense of shame and don’t understand courtesy, ..
.. might all be accused of being a “bastard”.
“You’re such a bastard” is extremely vicious abusive language, so it’s best not to use it.
